# 2 Baruch Chapter 54 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**54:1** And-thereupon I-awoke, and-I-arose, and-I-prayed and-said:

**54:2** "O-LORD, you-show-me much-and-you-teach-me many-things, but-you-show-me now something in-which I-am-not-able to-understand its-meaning.

**54:3** The-vision has-comforted me-in-part, but-in-part it-has-troubled-me; for-I-have-seen things-which-I-cannot-explain.

**54:4** "I-entreat-you therefore, O-LORD my-God, to-interpret-to-me this-vision.

**54:5** For-I-know that-those-things which-I-asked-for earlier you-have-shown-me;

**54:6** and-now, I-pray-you to-show-me also the-interpretation-of-this-vision.

**54:7** "For-at-the-end-of-the-world retribution-will-come for-the-wicked, and-for-the-righteous a-new-world will-be-opened.

**54:8** And-because-we-have-not-received that-world, we-have-not-been-found worthy-of-it;

**54:9** but-because-we-have-suffered much in-this-world, therefore we-have-been-found worthy-of-the-world-to-come.

**54:10** "For-of-all-the-things which-the-world-has, which-is-coming — man-cannot-know.

**54:11** For-not-for-man has-this-world-been-created, but-for-man has-the-world-to-come-been-prepared.

**54:12** For-this-world-is-to-man a-trouble and-a-weariness with-much-labour; and-that-world-to-come-will-be-a-crown with-great-glory.

**54:13** "O-LORD, I-therefore-cry-out-unto-you, and-I-ask-of-you: do-not let-my-sin-and-my-transgression prevail-against-me;

**54:14** and-remember-me before-you, and-let-not the-deeds-of-men prevail-against-me.

**54:15** For-since-the-beginning I-have-been your-servant, and-I-have-given-myself over to-your-service.

**54:16** "Now therefore I-entreat-you, O-LORD God: let-your-mercy-be-great upon-us, and-let-it-not-come-upon-us according-to-our-deeds,

**54:17** but according-to-your-loving-kindness.

**54:18** "For-if-you-reward us according-to-our-works, we-have-nothing with-which to-answer-you.

**54:19** For-what-are-we that-we-should-speak-to-you? For-we-are-dust before-you.

**54:20** O-LORD our-God, save-us for-your-name's-sake.

**54:21** "For-you-have-created-us, and-you-have-mercy upon-those-you-have-created; and-you-do-not-forsake your-creatures.

**54:22** For-every-man-who-has-been-born has-sinned; but-you, O-LORD, forgive-them and-have-mercy-on-them."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
